en.page.title: Zhiliang Long - Research
en.header.name: Zhiliang Long
en.about.body: Hi! I'm Zhiliang Long. I am a master's candidate at Shenzhen University (CSSE), advised by MARK JunJie Li. I explore the intersection of natural language understanding and database reasoning, focusing on NL2SQL, LLM reasoning reliability, and multi-agent methods.

zh.page.title: 龙智亮 - 研究主页
zh.header.name: 龙智亮（Zhiliang Long）
zh.header.tagline: 硕士研究生 - 深圳大学计算机与软件学院
zh.about.body: 你好！我是龙智亮（Zhiliang Long）。我是深圳大学（计算机与软件学院）的硕士研究生，导师为李俊杰（MARK JunJie Li）。我的研究方向是自然语言理解与数据库推理的交叉，关注 NL2SQL、LLM 推理可靠性与多智能体方法。

news.en: My first NL2SQL work was submitted to a CCF-A conference.
news.zh: 自己的第一个NL2SQL的工作投在了 CCF-A类会议。

news.en: Achieved 2,050 points on LeetCode; Knight title; top 6% nationwide.
news.zh: 在 LeetCode 上获得 2,050 分，获得 Knight 称号，位列全国前 6%。

desc.en: Improved answer generation and tool use for an enterprise knowledge assistant through on-policy distillation and evaluation of retrieval, citations, and tool calls.
desc.zh: 参与企业知识问答 Agent 的优化，使用在策略蒸馏（OPD）改进答案生成，并评估检索、引用与工具调用。

role.zh: 抖音研发 · 代码修复 Agent

desc.en: Built an agent that reproduces bugs, generates patches, and verifies fixes through builds, unit tests, and CI checks.
desc.zh: 构建代码修复 Agent，串联缺陷复现、补丁生成、编译、单元测试与 CI 验证。

desc.en: Optimized small models for software engineering tasks through trajectory synthesis, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and test-time search.
desc.zh: 通过轨迹合成、监督微调、强化学习和推理时搜索，优化小模型在软件工程任务上的表现。
